Then one decision record is written and no second reopen is reported

  Scenario: AC15 Consumed call fails with an error answer (failed call, not the unanswered case of AC7)
    Given a consumed service returns an error answer to the step
    When the step runs
    Then nothing is written and the caller sees the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC16 Disallowed status change refused (transition the model does not allow)
    Given a status change the model does not allow is submitted
    When the command is submitted
    Then the change is refused, nothing is recorded and the answer code is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S1-E4011-APP-AC16)
